When you have the actual picture, record your QC determination on that turn and give me the call: if it is genuinely marketing-ready, sign it off; if it is not, say so plainly and hold it, because it does not go to listing until every outstanding scope is closed and signed off. Open a ticket on the issue tracker spelling out exactly what is still left on it, post where it lands in the make-ready channel, and get an email together for Carlos with the specifics. If I am holding it back, Brooke needs to hear it from us before she markets it.

parameters.subject: QC Determination: Hold Listing for Mesa Vista 4C Turn
parameters.body:
Hi Carlos,

I completed my Quality Control pass on Mesa Vista Unit 4C following your update that the June turnover was wrapped. 

After auditing the unit status across our systems, Mesa Vista 4C is NOT marketing-ready, and I am placing a QC HOLD on the unit. Per QC standards, a turn cannot be released for listing until every outstanding scope is finished, billed, paid, and signed off.

Here is the exact breakdown of what is preventing sign-off:

1. Deep Clean Scope (Sunshine Cleaning): Vendor bill 2026-SC-4C ($387.00) is recorded in QuickBooks but remains UNPAID. A scope with an unpaid vendor bill is not closed.
2. Interior Repaint Scope (Pete Donovan): No vendor bill for Pete Donovan's repaint work exists or has been processed in QuickBooks (and owner pass-through invoice 2026-537 is unposted in QB).
3. QC Re-Inspection: The final QC re-inspection is scheduled on the calendar for mid-July 2026. QC sign-off cannot occur until this re-inspection is completed and passed.

I have opened issue ticket OPS-1000 in Linear (https://linear.app/synthetic/issue/OPS-1000) to track these items and posted the hold status in the #make-ready channel. Brooke is CC'd here so she has direct notice before any listing or marketing activity begins.

Please resolve the QuickBooks bill/invoice discrepancies and align on the mid-July re-inspection so we can sign off on this turn.

Best regards,

Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector
Star Property Management
